column3: NASB puts the second part in parentheses.
“Naphath of Dor” is rendered “the height of Dor.”
“Villages” is rendered “towns,” and NASB adds parentheses.
“One overseer” is rendered “the only deputy”; the meaning is uncertain.
MT 5:4. “The other side of the River” is rendered “west of the River.”
MT 5:9. “Breadth of heart” is rendered “breadth of mind.”
MT 5:10. “The people of the east” is rendered “the sons of the east.”
